mapper.select: SELECT U.ID AS id, U.USERNAME AS username, U.PASSWORD AS password, U.NAME AS name, U.EMAIL AS email, U.PHONE AS phone, U.ROLE AS role, (SELECT MIN(A.PROVIDER) FROM MB_USER_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT A WHERE A.USER_ID = U.ID) AS loginProvider FROM MB_USER U WHERE U.USERNAME = #{username}

SELECT U.ID AS id, U.USERNAME AS username, U.PASSWORD AS password, U.NAME AS name, U.EMAIL AS email, U.PHONE AS phone, U.ROLE AS role, A.PROVIDER AS loginProvider FROM MB_USER U JOIN MB_USER_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT A ON A.USER_ID = U.ID WHERE A.PROVIDER = #{provider} AND A.SOCIAL_ID = #{socialId}

SELECT U.ID AS id, U.USERNAME AS username, U.NAME AS name, U.EMAIL AS email, U.PHONE AS phone, U.ROLE AS role, (SELECT MIN(A.PROVIDER) FROM MB_USER_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT A WHERE A.USER_ID = U.ID) AS loginProvider FROM MB_USER U WHERE LOWER(U.EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
